name: 5dive-browser
description: The 5dive browser plugin, published from its own repository. One plugin, one repo — the shape `5dive plugin add <owner>/<repo>` was built for.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Persistent human-authenticated browser sessions: you log into a site once by hand, the agent is granted the session and never the credentials, and deterministic adapters decide where to click. A security challenge is a hard stop that asks for a person.
